about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: French Vinaigrette a la Moutarde Dijon Mustard Dressing
recipes.summary: The everyday French dressing of mustard, red wine vinegar and olive oil, emulsified until glossy.
steps: Whisk the mustard, vinegar, shallot, salt, pepper and honey in a bowl until combined.
Pour in the oil in a thin stream, whisking until thick and glossy.
Taste and adjust the salt or vinegar to your liking.
Toss with the salad leaves just before serving.
notes: Keeps in a jar in the fridge for 2 weeks; shake well before using.

recipes.title: Japanese Wafu Onion Dressing for Grilled Meat and Salads
recipes.summary: Grated onion, soy and rice vinegar dressing that is savoury, sweet and sharp, spooned over salad or steak.
steps: Simmer the mirin for 1 minute to cook off the alcohol, then cool.
Mix the onion, soy sauce, vinegar, oils, sugar and ginger in a jar.
Add the cooled mirin and shake for 20 seconds until blended.
Leave for 10 minutes so the onion mellows before using.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 5 days.

recipes.title: Thai Nam Prik Pao Roasted Chilli Jam
recipes.summary: Sweet, smoky chilli jam of dried chilli, garlic and shallot, stirred into soups, noodles and fried eggs.
steps: Toast the chillies in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant and darker, then soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Fry the garlic and shallots in half the oil for 6 minutes until golden, then cool.
Blend the chillies, garlic and shallots to a coarse paste.
Fry the paste in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, add the sugar, tamarind, fish sauce and water and simmer for 6 minutes until dark and jammy.
Cool and spoon into a clean jar.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Thai Panang Curry Paste
recipes.summary: Rich dry red curry paste with roasted peanuts and coriander seed, the base of panang curry.

items: 8 dried red chillies, deseeded and soaked

steps: Toast the coriander and cumin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant, then grind finely.
Drain the chillies and chop with the lemongrass.
Crush or blend everything together with the peanuts, salt, zest and oil to a smooth thick paste.
Scrape the paste into a clean jar and press it down.
notes: Use 3 tbsp per can of coconut milk with chicken or tofu; keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Thai Yellow Curry Paste
recipes.summary: Mild golden curry paste of turmeric, lemongrass and dried chilli with warm spices.

items: 6 dried red chillies, deseeded and soaked

steps: Drain the chillies and chop them with the lemongrass.
Blend with the shallots, garlic, ginger, turmeric, coriander, cumin, salt and oil to a smooth paste, scraping the bowl often.
Fry a teaspoon of paste in a pan for 30 seconds until fragrant, to check the balance.
Spoon into a jar and cover with a film of oil.
notes: Use 3 tbsp per can of coconut milk with chicken, potato and onion; keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Malaysian Rendang Spice Paste
recipes.summary: Fragrant blended paste of galangal, lemongrass and chilli that flavours beef, chicken or jackfruit rendang.

items: 8 dried red chillies, deseeded and soaked

steps: Drain the chillies and chop with the shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal and lemongrass.
Blend with the turmeric and 1 tbsp oil to a smooth paste.
Fry the paste in the remaining oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until the oil separates and the aroma is deep.
Stir in the salt and cool.
notes: Use 5 tbsp per 1 kg of meat; freezes for 3 months in ice cube trays.

recipes.title: Indian Tandoori Chicken Marinade and Oven Chicken
recipes.summary: Yoghurt, lemon and spice marinade that gives chicken thighs the smoky red look of the tandoor.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, lemon juice, ginger, garlic, spices, salt and oil, then coat the chicken and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 230°C and line a tray.
Arrange the chicken on a rack on the tray and roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and 75°C inside.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with lemon and onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until 75°C in the thickest part. Discard the used marinade and wash hands and board after raw chicken.

recipes.title: Goan Vindaloo Curry Paste
recipes.summary: Hot, tangy Goan paste of dried chilli, vinegar and warm spices for pork, beef or potatoes.

items: 10 dried red chillies, deseeded and soaked

steps: Toast the cumin, peppercorns, cloves and cinnamon in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant, then grind fine.
Blend the drained chillies, garlic, ginger, ground spices, turmeric, vinegar, sugar and salt to a smooth paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 4 minutes until the oil separates and it darkens.
Cool completely and spoon into a clean jar.
notes: Use 4 tbsp per 600g of meat or vegetables; keeps in the fridge for 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Criollo Garlic and Citrus Marinade
recipes.summary: Garlicky sour orange style marinade and sauce, hot oil poured over raw garlic and citrus.
steps: Mix the garlic, orange juice, lime juice, cumin, oregano and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the oil in a small pan for 2 minutes until shimmering and pour over the garlic mixture, stirring as it sizzles.
Cool for 10 minutes and add the coriander.
Use as a marinade for pork or chicken, or as a sauce over yuca and rice.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

recipes.title: Korean Bulgogi Beef and Lettuce Wraps
recipes.summary: Thinly sliced beef in a sweet soy and pear marinade, grilled quickly and wrapped in lettuce.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, pear and spring onions, add the beef and marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over high heat until smoking.
Cook the beef in two batches for 3 minutes each, until browned and the centre reaches 71°C.
Serve in lettuce leaves with rice and chilli paste.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until 71°C in the centre, and discard any raw marinade left in the bowl.

recipes.title: Spanish Alioli Garlic Emulsion
recipes.summary: Traditional garlic and olive oil sauce, pounded smooth and whisked in the old way with an egg yolk for stability.
steps: Crush the garlic and salt to a smooth paste in a bowl.
Whisk in the egg yolk until pale.
Add the oil drop by drop at first, then in a thin stream, whisking until thick and glossy.
Stir in the lemon juice and taste for salt.
notes: Food safety: raw egg yolk is not recommended for pregnant women, young children, older people or anyone vulnerable; use pasteurised egg. Keep chilled and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Georgian Adjika Fresh Chilli and Walnut Paste
recipes.summary: Sharp, herby red chilli paste with garlic, walnuts and coriander, stirred into soups and grilled meat.
steps: Chop the chillies, garlic and fresh coriander roughly, until evenly small.
Blend with the walnuts, ground coriander, paprika, salt and vinegar to a coarse paste.
Taste and adjust the salt and vinegar.
Rest for 30 minutes before using.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 10 days.

recipes.title: Georgian Satsebeli Plum Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Sweet and sour cooked tomato sauce with garlic and coriander, a table sauce for grilled meats and potatoes.
steps: Simmer the tomatoes with the sugar and salt for 20 minutes until reduced and thick.
Stir in the garlic, chilli, vinegar and oil and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the coriander and cool.
Spoon the sauce into a clean jar and cool.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 5 days.

recipes.title: Armenian Aubergine and Walnut Spread
recipes.summary: Roasted aubergine mashed with walnuts, garlic and parsley, served as a dip or spread.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and roast the whole aubergines for 35 minutes until collapsed and soft.
Scoop out the flesh and drain in a sieve for 5 minutes.
Blend the flesh with the walnuts, garlic, lemon juice, oil and salt to a rough paste.
Fold in the parsley and serve with warm pita.
notes: Pierce the aubergine skin before roasting so steam can escape.

recipes.title: Swiss Rosti Golden Potato Cake
recipes.summary: Grated potato pressed and fried in butter until golden and crisp outside, soft within.

items: 700g waxy potatoes, boiled for 8 minutes and cooled

steps: Peel and coarsely grate the cooled potatoes and toss with the salt and pepper.
Heat half the butter and the oil in a pan and press in the potato in an even cake.
Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes until golden, then flip using a plate and add the rest of the butter.
Cook for 10 minutes more, then fry the eggs and serve on top.
notes: Food safety: fry the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: German Bratkartoffeln Pan-Fried Potatoes with Onion
recipes.summary: Sliced cooked potatoes fried in butter with onion until deeply golden and crisp edged.
steps: Slice the cooled potatoes about 5 mm thick.
Heat the oil and half the butter in a large pan and fry the potatoes in a single layer for 12 minutes, turning only once, until golden.
Add the onion and remaining butter and cook for 8 minutes until the onion is soft and caramelised.
Season and scatter with parsley.
notes: Leave the potatoes undisturbed so they crisp rather than steam.

recipes.title: Swedish Hasselbackspotatis Fanned Roast Potatoes
recipes.summary: Whole potatoes sliced into fans and roasted with butter and breadcrumbs until crisp on top.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and slice each potato crosswise nearly through, every 3 mm.
Brush with the butter and oil, season with the salt and roast for 35 minutes.
Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs, cheese and thyme.
Roast for 15 minutes more until golden and a knife slides in easily.
notes: Rest the potatoes on wooden spoons while slicing to stop the knife cutting through.

recipes.title: Belgian Liege Waffles with Brown Sugar
recipes.summary: Yeasted waffle dough with butter and caramelising sugar for a chewy golden waffle.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then stir in the milk and eggs to a sticky dough.
Beat in the soft butter and vanilla, then cover and prove for 1 hour until doubled.
Fold in the brown sugar until just marbled, then divide into 6 balls.
Cook each ball in a hot waffle iron for 4 minutes until deeply golden.
notes: Food safety: cook the waffles until the egg is cooked through and the centre is hot.

recipes.title: Dutch Poffertjes Mini Pancakes with Butter and Icing Sugar
recipes.summary: Small puffy yeasted pancakes, served hot with melting butter and icing sugar.
steps: Whisk the flours, yeast, milk, egg, salt and sugar into a smooth batter and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a pan with a little butter and drop small spoonfuls of batter in, cooking for 1 minute until bubbles show.
Flip with a fork and cook for 1 minute more until puffed and golden.
Serve piled high with butter and icing sugar.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Finnish Ohukaiset Thin Pancakes with Berries
recipes.summary: Thin lacy pancakes made with a milky batter and served with jam or fruit.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs, salt and sugar into a thin smooth batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a hot pan and pour in a thin ladle of batter, swirling to cover.
Cook for 1 minute each side until golden and lacy.
Fold and serve with jam and yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Hungarian Palacsinta Crepes with Apricot Jam
recipes.summary: Thin Hungarian crepes, rolled around apricot jam and dusted with icing sugar.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, soda water, eggs, salt and sugar into a thin batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Brush a pan with oil and pour in a thin layer of batter, cooking for 1 minute each side until golden.
Spread each crepe with jam and roll up.
Dust the rolled crepes generously with icing sugar.
notes: Food safety: cook the crepes until the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Indonesian Martabak Manis Thick Sweet Pancake
recipes.summary: A thick, honeycombed pancake filled with chocolate sprinkles, peanuts and condensed milk.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs, milk, sugar and bicarb into a smooth batter and rest for 20 minutes.
Pour into a greased lidded pan over medium heat and cook for 10 minutes until bubbles form and the top is nearly set.
Scatter with peanuts and chocolate chips, drizzle with condensed milk, fold in half and brush with butter.
Cut in squares and serve warm.
notes: Food safety: cook the batter until the top is no longer wet and the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Korean Hobak Juk Sweet Pumpkin Porridge
recipes.summary: Smooth rice and pumpkin porridge, mellow and slightly sweet, served warm.
steps: Boil the pumpkin in the water for 20 minutes until completely soft.
Blend until smooth, then return to the pot.
Whisk in the rice flour mixed with 3 tbsp cold water and simmer for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Season with the sugar and salt and top with the pine nuts.
notes: Stir constantly as it thickens to avoid lumps.

recipes.title: Korean Dakjuk Chicken and Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Comforting rice porridge cooked in a ginger and chicken broth with shredded chicken.
steps: Simmer the chicken in the water with the garlic and ginger for 15 minutes until cooked through at 75°C, then lift out and shred.
Add the rice and carrot to the broth and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring often, until soft and creamy.
Stir in the shredded chicken, sesame oil and salt.
Serve with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until 75°C in the thickest part and chill leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Scottish Skirlie Toasted Oatmeal and Onion Side
recipes.summary: Toasted oats fried with onion in butter, a nutty traditional side or stuffing.
steps: Melt the butter in a pan and cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the oats and toast over medium heat for 6 minutes, stirring, until golden and fragrant.
Season with salt, pepper and the parsley.
Serve warm with roast meat or soup once the oats are crisp.
notes: Serve under a poached egg for a quick breakfast.

recipes.title: Persian Tahdig Crispy Saffron Rice
recipes.summary: Fluffy rice with a golden crust of saffron and yoghurt baked in the base of the pot.
steps: Soak the rice in warm water with the salt for 1 hour, then drain and boil for 6 minutes until al dente.
Bloom the saffron in the hot water, then mix half with the yoghurt and 3 tbsp rice.
Heat the oil and 2 tbsp butter in a non-stick pot, spread the yoghurt rice over the base and pile the rest on top.
Cover with a towel-wrapped lid and steam on low for 40 minutes until a golden crust forms.
Drizzle with the remaining butter and saffron water, then invert onto a plate.
notes: Dip the pot base in cold water for 1 minute before inverting so the crust releases.

recipes.title: Mexican Arroz Rojo Tomato Rice
recipes.summary: Fluffy long-grain rice toasted in oil and cooked in a blended tomato, onion and garlic broth.
steps: Blend the tomato, onion and garlic with a splash of the stock until smooth.
Fry the rice in the oil for 4 minutes until pale golden.
Add the tomato mix and cook for 3 minutes, then add the stock, carrot, peas and salt.
Cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed, then rest for 5 minutes.
notes: Use vegetable stock to keep it plant-based.

recipes.title: Cuban Moros y Cristianos Black Beans and Rice
recipes.summary: Black beans cooked with rice, green capsicum, garlic and cumin in one pot.
steps: Cook the onion, capsicum and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes until soft, then add the cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the rice, beans with liquid, bay leaf, water and salt.
Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 22 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir in the vinegar and remove the bay leaf.
notes: Serve with sliced avocado and lime.

recipes.title: Turkish Bulgur Pilav with Vermicelli and Tomato
recipes.summary: Nutty bulgur cooked with toasted vermicelli, tomato paste and butter.
steps: Melt the butter and cook the vermicelli for 2 minutes until golden, then add the onion for 4 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute, add the bulgur and toast for 2 minutes.
Add the stock, salt and pepper and simmer covered on low for 12 minutes until absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
notes: Swap the butter for olive oil to keep it dairy-free.

recipes.title: Greek Dakos Cretan Barley Rusk Salad
recipes.summary: Crunchy rusks softened by grated tomato and topped with feta, olives and oregano.

items: 4 barley rusks (or thick dried bread slices)

steps: Wet the rusks with a splash of water for 20 seconds until slightly softened but still chewy.
Top with the grated tomato.
Crumble over the feta and scatter with olives, capers and oregano.
Drizzle with the olive oil.
notes: Eat straight after assembling so the rusks keep some crunch.

recipes.title: Mexican Esquites Charred Corn Cup
recipes.summary: Charred corn tossed with mayonnaise, lime, chilli and cotija style cheese, served in a cup.
steps: Char the corn kernels in the oil in a hot pan for 8 minutes, stirring, until deeply golden.
Mix with the mayonnaise, lime juice and chilli powder while still warm.
Spoon into cups and top with the feta and coriander.
Serve warm in cups with extra lime wedges.
notes: Serve with extra lime wedges.
